slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Surface area: prism, the sum of all face areas (2B + Ph for a right prism). Right circular cylinder, 2πr2 + 2πrh. Regular pyramid, B + (1/2)Pℓ. For a right circular cone, total surface area is πr²+πrℓ. For a right circular cylinder use 2πr²+2πrh. Do not apply these simple lateral formulas to arbitrary oblique solids. Sphere, 4πr2.

Here ℓ is the slant height, measured along the face, which is longer than the height h. Unfold a solid into its net and add the areas of the pieces; the curved side of a cylinder unrolls into a rectangle 2πr by h.
